relations.note: Seraphim surround God’s throne, proclaim holiness, and perform purification.

relations.myth: Cherubim guard and bear the divine presence
relations.note: Cherubim guard sacred space and form or bear God’s throne.
God creates the angelic nature from nothing as spiritual beings.

relations.myth: Conflict with the prince of Persia
relations.note: Michael aids a heavenly messenger opposed by Persia’s angelic prince.
Michael disputes with the Devil over the body of Moses.
Michael and his angels fight and defeat the Dragon and his angels.
Thrones, dominions, rulers, and authorities are created through and for Christ.
Angelic and cosmic powers are subordinated to the exalted Christ.
Named archangels execute divine judgments against the rebel Watchers.
Named archangels execute divine judgments against the giants fathered by Watchers.
Raphael binds the demon Asmodeus during his journey with Tobias.

relations.myth: Formation of the lower archonic hierarchy
relations.note: Archons and angels are generated or organized beneath the ignorant ruler.
relations.source: Hypostasis of the Archons; Apocryphon of John

relations.myth: Reorganization of the lower archonic order
relations.note: Her action exposes or reorganizes the lower hierarchy of archons and angels.
relations.source: Hypostasis of the Archons and related texts

relations.note: All nine orders receive and mediate God’s purification, illumination, and perfection.
Powers, Michael, and other armed angels restrain or defeat demons.
Occult tables pair each angelic choir with an opposing demonic order.
